title: Stubborn Runaway Juvenile Thinks She Can Overpower Cop
description:
On 18th January 2022, officers were dispatched in response to a runaway juvenile, a female known to the police from previous encounters. Here’s what happened next. The female was unwilling to comply with the officers and continued to make things difficult for them. Here's what the wardens of the juvenile home shared with the police. The female was charged with battery upon a peace officer and resisting arrest.
